title: Core Network Architect
description:
Job Title: Core Network Clienthitect
Engagement Duration: 6 Months
Location: Remote


Overview:
We are seeking a seasoned Core Network Clienthitect to serve as a strategic technical advisor for a global client. This senior-level role focuses on high-level network Clienthitecture and design, supporting business-critical initiatives across corporate, manufacturing, distribution, and retail environments.

Key Responsibilities:
Clienthitectural Design: Lead the design of enterprise network solutions tailored to complex global operations.
RFP Support: Act as the technical lead for network components in RFPs, including proposal writing and cost modeling.
Technical Advisory: Guide clients on network strategy, technology selection, and alignment with long-term business goals.
Multi-Layer Expertise: Provide Clienthitectural leadership across Layer 1 to Layer 3, including fiber optics, switching, and routing protocols.
Global Collaboration: Work closely with distributed teams to ensure seamless execution and
communication.
Required Qualifications:
Experience: 10+ years in network engineering/Clienthitecture, preferably in consumer goods, retail, or manufacturing.
RFP Expertise: Demonstrated experience in enterprise-level RFPs and proposal development.
Technical Depth: Strong knowledge of Layer 1 (fiber, DWDM), Layer 2 (Ethernet, switching), and Layer 3 (IP routing, BGP, OSPF).
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.
Strategic Focus: Proven success in strategic, non-hands-on roles.
Client-Facing Skills: Experience in advisory roles with external clients.
Certifications: CCIE or equivalent network Clienthitecture/design certifications preferred.
